description:
Use this when the user wants the raw daily NSE rows for a security, including SME stocks, bonds, G-secs, SGBs or fund units, with delivery and trade counts.

Daily NSE bhavcopy rows for one security in any series it trades in.

    `symbol` is an NSE symbol or ISIN; SME stocks, bonds, G-secs, SGBs, T-bills and fund units work
    too, which get_price_history does not carry. `series` narrows to one (EQ, BE, SM, GB...). Window: `days`
    back from the newest stored day (default 30, max 1825) or `from_date`/`to_date`. Each row: open,
    high, low, close, last, prev_close, volume, turnover, trades, delivery quantity and %. Prices are
    as NSE published them that day, NOT adjusted for splits or bonus issues (`adjusted: false`); use
    get_price_history for an adjusted series. Raw rows, no commentary.
name: get_security_history
title: Daily history, any NSE series
